If you complain to us about the condition of the house where you live, and if as a result of this complaint we send your landlord  a ‘relevant notice’ (see below), then, after we have sent that notice, your landlord cannot give you a section 21 notice for the next 6 months (i.e. a notice requiring you to leave the property / an eviction letter), apart from when the 'relevant notice' is cancelled or reversed, or if the landlord appeals.
